name: claude_compact_auto
description: Auto-compact after three inline Bash results of 110000 bytes. The default inline cap is 30000 and the ceiling is 128000, so settings.bashOutputMaxChars is 120000 and --bare is omitted (it skips settings). The window is 100000 and the threshold is about effectiveWindow-13000 tokens. A 20k-character prompt stayed near 95% of that window on Claude Code 2.1.310: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE did not lower it. The assistant reply after the summary is the continuity in the same file.
